newsitem.title: USA: ABC Radio to move ahead with Radio Disney.
newsitem.headline: ABC Radio to move ahead with Radio Disney.

text.p: ABC Radio Networks said it plans to move forward with a national rollout of Radio Disney, a network geared toward children and family-oriented programming.
Radio Disney debuted on November 18 in four markets: Atlanta, Minneapolis, Salt Lake City and Birmingham.

"ABC Radio has launched into a new frontier," ABC Radio Division President Bob Callahan said in a statement. "ABC and Disney are poised to offer radio programming to a new and enthusiastic audience. Radio Disney will serve as a great medium to entertain and educate families."
ABC Radio said that Radio Disney's test phase witnessed solid interest from a large number of blue-chip advertisers, and that it has received significant interest from owners of radio stations.
Radio Disney's format includes a Top 40-style playlist of songs and several short-form features per hour, such as ABC News for Kids, ESPN Sports for Kids and Kid of the Week.
